info.title: Containers
info.description: The Docker containers and Compose stacks of this machine: see what runs, start, stop and restart it, read its logs.

x-app.description: The Docker containers and Compose stacks of this machine: see what runs, start, stop and restart it, read its logs.

methods.name: overview
methods.summary: Whether Docker can be reached, and every container and Compose stack it has. A Docker that cannot be reached is an answer (`engine.reachable` is false and says why), not an error.

methods.name: connect
methods.summary: Choose the Docker this app manages, and answer with what it has.

params.name: host
params.description: Where Docker listens: `unix:///path/docker.sock`, `tcp://host:2375` or `http://host:2375`. Empty for this machine's own Docker.

errors.message: The address is not one Docker can be reached at.

params.name: container
params.description: The id of one of the containers of `overview`.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

methods.name: stop
methods.summary: Stop a container: Docker asks it to end, and kills it after ten seconds.

params.name: container
params.description: The id of one of the containers of `overview`.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

methods.name: restart
methods.summary: Stop a container and start it again.

params.name: container
params.description: The id of one of the containers of `overview`.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: Remove a container, running or not. Its named volumes stay.

params.name: container
params.description: The id of one of the containers of `overview`.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

methods.name: startStack
methods.summary: Start every container of a Compose stack, the services others depend on first.

params.name: stack
params.description: The name of one of the stacks of `overview`.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

methods.name: stopStack
methods.summary: Stop every container of a Compose stack, the services others depend on last.

params.name: stack
params.description: The name of one of the stacks of `overview`.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

methods.name: restartStack
methods.summary: Stop a Compose stack and start it again.

params.name: stack
params.description: The name of one of the stacks of `overview`.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

methods.name: removeStack
methods.summary: Take a Compose stack down: remove its containers and its networks. Its volumes stay.

params.name: stack
params.description: The name of one of the stacks of `overview`.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

methods.name: details
methods.summary: What a container was made with: its command, restart policy, mounts, networks and the names of its environment variables.

params.name: container
params.description: The id of one of the containers of `overview`.

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

methods.name: logs
methods.summary: The end of what a container has written, both its output and its errors, as text.

params.name: container
params.description: The id of one of the containers of `overview`.

params.name: tail
params.description: How many lines from the end (200 when left out).

errors.message: Docker cannot be reached, the container or stack is gone, or Docker refused: the message says which.

version.description: Docker's version, empty when it cannot be reached.

host.description: Where Docker is looked for, as given to `connect`. Empty for this machine's own Docker.

problem.description: Why Docker cannot be reached, as a sentence. Empty when it can.

status.description: Docker's own words for the state: `Up 2 hours`, `Exited (0) 3 days ago`.

ports.description: The published ports, each as `8080:80` (the machine's port, then the container's).

stack.description: The Compose stack it belongs to; empty for a container on its own.

service.description: Its service in the stack; empty for a container on its own.

running.description: How many of its containers are running.

folder.description: The folder it was brought up from; empty when Compose did not record one.

containers.description: Every container, running or not, by name.

stacks.description: The Compose stacks the containers belong to, by name.

command.description: What it runs, as one line.

health.description: `healthy`, `unhealthy` or `starting` for a container with a health check; empty without one.

mounts.description: Each mount as `source -> path in the container`.

environment.description: The names of its environment variables. Their values are not sent: they often hold passwords.

truncated.description: The text is the end of something longer.
